svg.title: Timeline of the N-central exploit releases, 9 to 13 November 2026: a hotfix on the 10th, a new chain that beats it on the 12th, 21 servers mining within hours, and no fix by the 13th
svg.text: Five days from hotfix to "the hotfix is not enough"
N-able N-central, November 2026. Times are UTC where researchers published them.
Mon 9
Able2Shell: 30+ N-central flaws published with no warning
N-able takes hosted N-central offline and tells self-hosted customers to do the same
Tue 10
Hotfix 2 ships: N-central 2026.4, build 2026.4.1.26
Hosted servers patched and back online
Thu 12
4EverAble2Shell and Agent2Shell exploit code goes public
Works against servers already running Hotfix 2, if the Legacy API is on and reachable
First exploitation attempts seen
A honeypot captures the full chain, ending in root
21 mining rigs named after N-central servers appear in one pool
19 of the 21 were on Hotfix 2
later
N-able restricts the Legacy API and Intune integration
Fri 13
N-able reports new indicators of compromise. No patch yet.
Sources: N-able statements via BankInfoSecurity, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek; SOCRadar
